title: The Cipher of the Fens
author: Gideon Coldharbour
blurb: Coral Sandoval, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
